text:
Foods in the first photo: 2 sushi rolls (maki, avocado and vegetable), about 2 pieces at roughly 30 g each, so about 60 g and 80 kcal. Two slices of toast, possibly French toast or a tofu-type item, about 2 slices at 35 g each, so about 70-90 g and about 200 kcal. One glass of orange juice, about 200 ml, which is about 200 g and 90 kcal.

In the second photo everything is eaten, with only a little juice left at the bottom of the glass, about 10 g.

Eaten totals:
- Sushi: about 60 g, 80 kcal
- Toast: about 80 g, 210 kcal
- Juice: about 190 g, 85 kcal

That gives about 330 g and 375 kcal.
